dft-vehicle-licensing.title: DfT vehicle licensing statistics
dft-vehicle-licensing.description: Quarterly counts of licensed vehicles in the United Kingdom, produced by the Department for Transport from DVLA registration data: how many vehicles are licensed, of what body type, running on what fuel, under private or company keepership, registered in which local authority.

police-crime-london.title: Street-level crime, outcomes and stop & search — London
police-crime-london.description: Every crime and anti-social-behaviour incident recorded by London's two territorial police forces (the Metropolitan Police Service and City of London Police) since December 2010, with case outcomes and stop & search records, as published on data.police.uk. The full history is assembled from data.police.uk's permanent monthly archives, each month taken from the most recent archive that contains it (the most-revised version). Locations are anonymised by data.police.uk; British Transport Police are excluded.

gla-trees.title: London public realm trees (GLA / GiGL)
gla-trees.description: Tree-level inventory of London's publicly maintained realm — around 1.14 million street, park and other public-land trees — collated by Greenspace Information for Greater London (GiGL) for the Greater London Authority from the boroughs, TfL, the Royal Parks and other public land managers, with species, location type, size and age where recorded, and a 2090 climate suitability score.

fsa-food-hygiene-london.title: FSA food hygiene ratings (FHRS) — London
fsa-food-hygiene-london.description: Every establishment rated under the Food Hygiene Rating Scheme in the 33 London local authorities (the 32 boroughs plus the City of London Corporation), published by the Food Standards Agency as one XML file per authority, regenerated daily. The FSA keeps no public history — each day's extract replaces the last — so the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags on this dataset are a historical record that is not available from the publisher.

tfl-network-demand.title: TfL network demand — daily station footfall and network journeys
tfl-network-demand.description: Daily demand on London's public transport network from Transport for London's open 'Network Demand' data (crowding.data.tfl.gov.uk): entry and exit taps at each of ~440 stations, and total Underground and bus journeys across the network, from January 2019. TfL publishes both as overlapping yearly and rolling two-year CSV files that it replaces about weekly, with late corrections and no public history. The tables here combine the overlapping files into single deduplicated daily series; the original files are kept alongside, and the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags preserve versions TfL no longer publishes. A station crosswalk, compiled for this dataset rather than published by TfL, links each footfall station label to TfL's station records (NaPTAN and hub IDs, lines, coordinates) and to National Rail CRS codes. Powered by TfL Open Data.

orr-station-usage.title: ORR estimates of station usage — Great Britain
orr-station-usage.description: How many people use each of Great Britain's ~2,600 mainline railway stations, from the Office of Rail and Road's annual Estimates of station usage: estimated entries, exits and interchanges at every station for each financial year from 1997-98. The figures are official statistics, estimated mainly from ticket sales rather than counted at gates.

tfl-journeys-by-mode.title: TfL public transport journeys by type of transport
tfl-journeys-by-mode.description: How many journeys are made on London's public transport each four-week TfL reporting period, by mode — bus, Underground, DLR, tram, London Overground, London Cable Car and Elizabeth line — from April 2010, as published by Transport for London on the London Datastore. TfL's headline ridership series, at the level TfL reports it.

dft-naptan.title: NaPTAN — National Rail stations (DfT)
dft-naptan.description: Great Britain's National Rail stations from the National Public Transport Access Nodes dataset (NaPTAN), the Department for Transport's national register of public transport access points: each station's CRS code, TIPLOC, stop area and location. NaPTAN publishes only its current state, so the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags here record how the register changes over time.

tfl-annual-rail-demand.title: TfL annual rail demand — station entry and exit counts
tfl-annual-rail-demand.description: Transport for London's annual figures for demand on its rail networks — the Underground, London Overground, DLR and Elizabeth line — from its open data bucket (crowding.data.tfl.gov.uk): entries and exits at every station on a typical day of each day type in the autumn count period, and TfL's weekly and annualised totals, for each year from 2017. Each year's workbook is kept alongside as published. Powered by TfL Open Data.

tfl-congestion-charge.title: TfL Congestion Charge zone — vehicles seen by month
tfl-congestion-charge.description: How many vehicles Transport for London's Congestion Charge cameras record in central London's charging zone each month, during charging hours, from July 2010: camera captures, confirmed vehicles observed, and charging days per month, as published by TfL on the London Datastore.

tfl-santander-cycles-hires.title: TfL Santander Cycles — number of hires
tfl-santander-cycles-hires.description: How many hires are made on London's Santander Cycles scheme each day since it opened on 30 July 2010, London-wide, as published by Transport for London on the London Datastore ('Number of Bicycle Hires'). The original spreadsheet, with TfL's monthly and yearly totals and average hire time, is kept alongside.

tfl-cycle-hire.title: TfL Santander Cycles — docking stations
tfl-cycle-hire.description: London's Santander Cycles hire network from Transport for London's open data: the inventory of docking stations from TfL's live BikePoint list — location, size, status and install date for around 800 stations. TfL publishes only the current list, so the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags here record how the network changes over time: stations added, removed, renamed, moved or resized. Powered by TfL Open Data.
